out/audio_turns/emb_001_t01_A.mp3: At the staff meeting today, I thought I could keep it quiet, but everyone heard it.
out/audio_turns/emb_001_t03_A.mp3: The room went still, and then someone opened a window.
out/audio_turns/emb_001_t04_B.mp3: That made it hard to pretend nothing had happened.
out/audio_turns/emb_001_t05_A.mp3: I said it was my chair, but nobody looked at the chair.
out/audio_turns/emb_001_t07_A.mp3: She was sitting right across from me, taking notes.
out/audio_turns/emb_003_t01_A.mp3: I was using the bathroom on the train in Rome, and the lock would not catch properly.
out/audio_turns/emb_003_t02_B.mp3: Did someone open the door before you could fix it?
out/audio_turns/emb_003_t03_A.mp3: A woman stepped in, and I was still trying to get the latch to stay shut.
out/audio_turns/emb_003_t04_B.mp3: At least the door was closed again after that.
out/audio_turns/emb_004_t01_A.mp3: I gave a presentation at work the other day, but my slides were still at home.
out/audio_turns/emb_004_t02_B.mp3: So you had to present without any of the material you prepared?
out/audio_turns/emb_004_t03_A.mp3: Yeah, I had to talk through everything from memory and use the whiteboard.
out/audio_turns/emb_004_t04_B.mp3: Did anyone have a copy of the slides, or were you on your own?
out/audio_turns/emb_004_t05_A.mp3: No one had them. I just kept going until the meeting was over.
out/audio_turns/emb_004_t06_B.mp3: At least you got through the whole presentation.
out/audio_turns/emb_005_t01_A.mp3: I was in Walmart with my son when he pulled a few things off a shelf onto the floor.
out/audio_turns/emb_005_t02_B.mp3: Did they all come down at once?
out/audio_turns/emb_005_t03_A.mp3: A couple of boxes and some packages landed around the cart, and people nearby looked over.
out/audio_turns/emb_005_t04_B.mp3: Was he still reaching for more while you were picking them up?
out/audio_turns/emb_005_t05_A.mp3: He had one more item in his hand, so I took that and started putting everything back.
out/audio_turns/emb_005_t06_B.mp3: Did anyone from the store come by?
out/audio_turns/emb_005_t07_A.mp3: An employee walked past, and I had the shelf mostly cleared by then.
out/audio_turns/emb_005_t08_B.mp3: At least it was only a few items instead of the whole display.
out/audio_turns/emb_006_t01_A.mp3: I forgot I had makeup on today and rubbed my face while I was walking to the store.
out/audio_turns/emb_006_t02_B.mp3: Did you notice anything was off before you got there?
out/audio_turns/emb_006_t03_A.mp3: Not until I caught my reflection in a window. The eyeliner was smeared across both sides of my face.
out/audio_turns/emb_006_t04_B.mp3: And you had already been walking around like that?
out/audio_turns/emb_006_t05_A.mp3: I had stopped for coffee and talked to the cashier.
out/audio_turns/emb_006_t07_A.mp3: No, so I only found out when I saw myself.
out/audio_turns/emb_007_t01_A.mp3: I farted at work today, right in the middle of a quiet meeting.
out/audio_turns/emb_007_t02_B.mp3: Did anyone know it was you?
out/audio_turns/emb_007_t03_A.mp3: The room went silent, and then someone opened a window.
out/audio_turns/emb_007_t05_A.mp3: I said nothing and kept looking at my notes.
out/audio_turns/emb_007_t06_B.mp3: Have they brought it up since?
out/audio_turns/emb_007_t07_A.mp3: Twice already. I do not think my co-workers will let me live it down.
out/audio_turns/emb_008_t01_A.mp3: I spilled tea on my lap today just before I had to leave. It soaked through the front of my pants.
out/audio_turns/emb_008_t02_B.mp3: Were you able to change, or did you have to go out like that?
out/audio_turns/emb_008_t03_A.mp3: I had no time, so I tied a sweater around my waist. The tea left a dark patch underneath.
out/audio_turns/emb_008_t04_B.mp3: That must have made the whole trip complicated.
out/audio_turns/emb_008_t05_A.mp3: Every time I looked down, the stain was still there. It looked like I'd had an accident.
out/audio_turns/emb_008_t06_B.mp3: Did anyone say anything when you arrived?
out/audio_turns/emb_009_t01_A.mp3: I rolled my ankle again walking over to the kitchen.
out/audio_turns/emb_009_t02_B.mp3: Was there anything in the way?
out/audio_turns/emb_009_t03_A.mp3: No, just the floor and a turn I have made plenty of times.
out/audio_turns/emb_009_t04_B.mp3: Is it the same ankle as last time?
out/audio_turns/emb_009_t05_A.mp3: Yeah, it seems to find a new angle whenever I am not paying attention.
out/audio_turns/emb_009_t06_B.mp3: Can you put weight on it?
out/audio_turns/emb_009_t07_A.mp3: A little. I have ice on it and I am trying not to move around.
out/audio_turns/emb_010_t01_A.mp3: The dress arrived this morning, and the label says a size smaller than I ordered.
out/audio_turns/emb_010_t02_B.mp3: And today was the day you planned to wear it?
out/audio_turns/emb_010_t03_A.mp3: I checked the order confirmation, and I had clicked the smaller size.
out/audio_turns/emb_010_t04_B.mp3: Was there enough time to find another one?
out/audio_turns/emb_010_t05_A.mp3: I borrowed a dress from my sister and changed the rest of the plan.
out/audio_turns/emb_010_t06_B.mp3: At least you had something that worked for the day.
out/audio_turns/emb_011_t01_A.mp3: I caught my toe on a raised bit of sidewalk the other day and went down.
out/audio_turns/emb_011_t02_B.mp3: Was anyone nearby when it happened?
out/audio_turns/emb_011_t03_A.mp3: No, the street was empty, so I got up and kept walking.
out/audio_turns/emb_011_t04_B.mp3: Did you check what made you catch your toe?
out/audio_turns/emb_011_t05_A.mp3: It was one loose edge in the pavement that I had walked past before.
out/audio_turns/emb_011_t06_B.mp3: Did you get any scrapes from it?
out/audio_turns/emb_011_t07_A.mp3: Just some dust on my clothes and a mark on one knee.
out/audio_turns/emb_011_t08_B.mp3: That bit of sidewalk may need someone to fix it.
out/audio_turns/emb_012_t01_A.mp3: I went to the grocery store this morning, and I noticed my wallet was at home when I reached the checkout line.
out/audio_turns/emb_012_t02_B.mp3: So you had already picked out everything and waited in line?
out/audio_turns/emb_012_t03_A.mp3: Yes, the cart was full, and the cashier had started ringing things up.
out/audio_turns/emb_012_t04_B.mp3: Did you leave the cart there and go back for your wallet?
out/audio_turns/emb_012_t05_A.mp3: I told the cashier what happened, put the items aside, and drove home for it.
out/audio_turns/emb_013_t01_A.mp3: I was on my first date last night, and I passed gas at the table.
out/audio_turns/emb_013_t03_A.mp3: She looked up for a second, and then we both kept talking about the menu.
out/audio_turns/emb_013_t04_B.mp3: So the date carried on after that?
out/audio_turns/emb_013_t05_A.mp3: Yeah, we finished dinner and walked around for a while afterward.
out/audio_turns/emb_013_t06_B.mp3: Did either of you mention it later?
out/audio_turns/emb_013_t07_A.mp3: No, we just said goodnight when her ride got there.
out/audio_turns/emb_013_t08_B.mp3: Maybe you will find out when you talk again.
out/audio_turns/emb_014_t01_A.mp3: I was just heading out with my coffee, and my foot went out from under me on the pavement.
out/audio_turns/emb_014_t02_B.mp3: Did anyone from the shop see you?
out/audio_turns/emb_014_t03_A.mp3: A barista came outside with napkins, and I was still holding the cup somehow.
out/audio_turns/emb_014_t04_B.mp3: At least the coffee stayed with you?
out/audio_turns/emb_014_t05_A.mp3: Most of it did, although my sleeve ended up wearing the rest.
out/audio_turns/emb_015_t01_A.mp3: I asked Maya if she wanted to get dinner after work today.
out/audio_turns/emb_015_t03_A.mp3: She said she already had plans, and the people by the coffee machine heard it.
out/audio_turns/emb_015_t04_B.mp3: Were they close enough to hear the whole question?
out/audio_turns/emb_015_t05_A.mp3: Close enough that someone stopped pouring coffee while she answered.
out/audio_turns/emb_015_t06_B.mp3: And then you still had to stand there and finish your drink.
out/audio_turns/emb_016_t01_A.mp3: I called Mr. Harris Mom during volleyball drills today.
out/audio_turns/emb_016_t03_A.mp3: He stopped the whistle and looked straight at me.
out/audio_turns/emb_016_t04_B.mp3: What did you say after that?
out/audio_turns/emb_016_t05_A.mp3: I said I meant to call for the ball, but everyone had already turned around.
out/audio_turns/emb_017_t01_A.mp3: I left my phone at Maya's place. It's unlocked, and she still has it.
out/audio_turns/emb_017_t02_B.mp3: Have you asked her to put it somewhere safe?
out/audio_turns/emb_017_t03_A.mp3: I sent a message, but I keep thinking about everything that's open on it.
out/audio_turns/emb_017_t04_B.mp3: She may just set it aside until you get there.
out/audio_turns/emb_018_t01_A.mp3: I just realized I've been walking around since breakfast with my pants unzipped. I only noticed when I sat down.
out/audio_turns/emb_018_t02_B.mp3: Did nobody say anything to you? That's a long time for no one to mention it.
out/audio_turns/emb_018_t03_A.mp3: I went to the pharmacy, got coffee, and stood in line at the bank.
out/audio_turns/emb_018_t04_B.mp3: Maybe people assumed someone else would tell you.
out/audio_turns/emb_018_t05_A.mp3: I caught my reflection in a shop window and finally saw it.
out/audio_turns/emb_018_t06_B.mp3: That makes it hard to tell whether anyone noticed.
out/audio_turns/emb_018_t07_A.mp3: I fixed it and kept thinking about every person who might have seen it.
out/audio_turns/emb_018_t08_B.mp3: Either way, the zipper stayed open through all of that.
out/audio_turns/emb_019_t01_A.mp3: I was biking home and couldn't hold it any longer. I had an accident before I got to the house.
out/audio_turns/emb_019_t02_B.mp3: You still had the rest of the ride ahead of you?
out/audio_turns/emb_019_t03_A.mp3: About a mile. I got home and went straight inside.
out/audio_turns/emb_019_t04_B.mp3: Did you have anything with you that helped on the way?
out/audio_turns/emb_019_t05_A.mp3: No, just my bike and what I was wearing. There was a lot to wash once I got home.
out/audio_turns/emb_019_t06_B.mp3: That made for a long trip home. Is everything cleaned up now?
out/audio_turns/emb_020_t01_A.mp3: I was shopping the other day and thought the cashier had charged me too much.
out/audio_turns/emb_020_t02_B.mp3: What made the total look wrong to you?
out/audio_turns/emb_020_t03_A.mp3: I compared it with the shelf label and asked her to check the price.
out/audio_turns/emb_020_t04_B.mp3: Did she find anything when she checked?
out/audio_turns/emb_020_t05_A.mp3: We went through the receipt, and I asked to speak with a manager when I still did not understand it.
out/audio_turns/emb_020_t07_A.mp3: The manager showed me that the sale label was for a different size than the one I bought.
out/audio_turns/emb_020_t08_B.mp3: So the total was right, but the label did not match your item.
out/audio_turns/emb_002_t01_A.mp3: I was in yoga class once, and during a stretch my pants split open.
out/audio_turns/emb_002_t02_B.mp3: Right in the middle of the class?
out/audio_turns/emb_002_t03_A.mp3: Yeah, we were all facing the mirrors, and I noticed a tear at the back.
out/audio_turns/emb_002_t05_A.mp3: The instructor just kept talking, so I tied my sweatshirt around my waist.
out/audio_turns/emb_002_t06_B.mp3: That was a practical move. How did you get through the rest of class?
out/audio_turns/emb_002_t07_A.mp3: I stayed near the wall until it was over, then went straight home.
